To The World-Traveler Sisters

Session on September 16, 2025 with Debbie & Judy

I was delighted to have served you tea last night. I hope the caffiene didn't keep you up too late!

The tea ceremony is not the same without my guests. And you two brought the energy that was very timely & synchronized.

Thank you, and I wish you well on your journey!
